hook.en: A plan for a college fest is useless until someone is in charge of the stage, someone of food, someone of tickets, and everyone knows whom to report to. That arranging is organising.
hook.kn: ಕಾಲೇಜು ಉತ್ಸವದ ಯೋಜನೆ ಇದ್ದರೂ ವೇದಿಕೆ, ಊಟ, ಟಿಕೆಟ್‌ಗೆ ಯಾರು ಹೊಣೆ, ಯಾರಿಗೆ ವರದಿ ಎಂದು ನಿಗದಿಯಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯೇ ಸಂಘಟನೆ.

narration.en: A plan for a college fest is useless until someone is in charge of the stage, someone of food, someone of tickets, and everyone knows whom to report to. That arranging is organising.

body.en: Organising is the process of identifying and grouping the work to be done, defining and delegating authority and responsibility, and establishing relationships so that people can work together to achieve objectives. It puts plans into action by arranging people, tasks and resources.

narration.en: Organising is the process of identifying and grouping the work to be done, defining and delegating authority and responsibility, and establishing relationships so that people can work together to achieve objectives. It puts plans into action by arranging people, tasks and resources.
narration.kn: ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ಗುಂಪು ಮಾಡುವುದು, ಅಧಿಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವುದು.

narration.kn: ಸಂಘಟನೆ ವಿಶೇಷೀಕರಣ, ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಸಂಬಂಧ, ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಉತ್ತಮ ಬಳಕೆ, ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ, ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಆಡಳಿತ, ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A Tumakuru printing press had three people doing every job. After organising, one handles design, one printing and one delivery, and each reports to the owner. Output doubled and nobody duplicates work. Identify the points of importance.

steps.en: Each person does one job repeatedly: benefits of specialisation.
Each knows that he reports to the owner: clarity in working relationships.
No duplication of work: optimum utilisation of resources.

answer.en: Specialisation, clarity in working relationships, and optimum utilisation of resources.
